title: Evaluating Multimodal Language Models as Visual Assistants for Visually Impaired Users

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing image captioning performance on a standard validation set versus a multicultural subset of the VizWiz dataset to assess whether models fail to recognize and describe culturally significant details.

Translating a visual question answering (VQA) dataset into 34 languages and comparing model accuracy across high-, medium-, and low-resource languages to identify performance disparities for non-English speakers.

Evaluating models' ability to act as assistive technologies by comparing video object recognition accuracy on general everyday objects versus specific assistive devices (e.g., white canes, Braille displays), as well as assessing their capability to comprehend optical Braille text.
